verdict.rationale: Logseq does not explicitly address AI training, but its architecture limits how much the vendor can see. It markets itself as a privacy-first, open-source, local-data knowledge base, its optional Sync is end-to-end encrypted, and pages are private by default unless published. That indirectly keeps notes away from the vendor, but there is no documented promise or opt-out about AI training. missing for 10: explicit no-AI-training policy or terms, documented training opt-out control, independent verification of data-handling claims
